dimensions.assessment: Affects senior Syrian officials, security personnel, militia leaders, and religious and ethnic minority communities in Syria, as well as U.S. foreign policy agencies.
dimensions.evidence: identifying senior Syrian officials and affiliated persons credibly alleged to have participated in... serious human rights abuses

dimensions.assessment: Calls for identifying individuals for potential targeted sanctions such as property blocking, visa ineligibility, and financial restrictions.
dimensions.evidence: Blocking and freezing property pursuant to the International Emergency Economic Powers Act

dimensions.assessment: The source does not state specific federal spending or revenue changes associated with the reporting or policy statements.
Requires an interagency report and determination by the Secretary of State and Director of National Intelligence within 90 days, while utilizing existing sanctions authorities.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 90 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of State... shall submit... a report

dimensions.assessment: Mandates a one-time report within 90 days, while supporting ongoing policy regarding targeted sanctions under existing federal authorities.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 90 days after the date of the enactment of this Act

importance_detail.rationale: Requires a report from the Secretary of State identifying senior Syrian officials alleged to have facilitated human rights abuses against minorities, and states policy regarding targeted sanctions.
